topography.project_purpose: Keyring provides enhanced depositor protection for DeFi users with instant zkVerification.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Governor family controls risk parameters and protocol configurations, which are enforced in the EulerSwap family through fee configs and registries. Multisig wallets serve as the administrative layer, likely holding ownership of governance contracts and executing privileged operations.
